# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Do not open a GitHub issue if you found a security vulnerability in Desgrana.
Instead:
- either open a private advisory:
  https://github.com/rdalverny/desgrana/security/advisories/new
- or contact the current maintainer directly: rwx@romaindalverny.com


## Supported Versions

Only the current major version (1.x) is supported.
